news.title: There's a pasta advert on the telly and the actors look like they're Italian from their ma…
news.author: lydiaconwell@todon.nl
news.snippet: There's a pasta advert on the telly and the actors look like they're Italian from their mannerisms. But their lips are speaking English so I assume # AI has been used to change the actors' mouths. But the effect is slightly unnerving. Us humans can see there's something amiss. The actors aren't English but show signs of speaking English. But their mannerisms don't match. It's weird and uncanny. Isn't this just like clown make-up where the happy face is painted on and we can all see the real face underneath? Isn't AI just the latest version of the killer clown? # KillerClowns # LLMs
